name: PropAI: 未ログインユーザーへ自動リマインドメール

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.email, p.last_login_at, p.plan, p.subscription_status FROM profiles p WHERE p.subscription_status = 'active' AND (p.last_login_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' OR p.last_login_at IS NULL) AND p.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
